addForwardingAddress.description: Open #settings/fwdandpop, poll for the form to render (can take 20-40s in a background tab), click the real "Add a forwarding address" button, fill the dialog's email input, click Next. Never touches the inline 'Forward a copy of incoming mail to' textbox (typing into it directly auto-selects that radio and forwards ALL mail). Never answers the follow-on challenge.

returns.description: {status:'challenge', targetId, popupTargetId} when Google opens a Verify-it's-you popup (accounts.google.com); {status:'sent', targetId} when it goes straight to a confirmation email; {stop:reason} at the step that failed

confirmForwarding.description: Open a mail-settings.google.com/mail/vf-... confirmation link from the forwarding-confirmation email and click Confirm.

verifyUrl.description: the vf-... link from the confirmation email

returns.description: {targetId, successText} the page's visible text after clicking Confirm; {stop:reason} otherwise

createForwardFilter.description: Open #search/<query>, Advanced search options -> Create filter, tick "Forward it to" (checkboxes render off-screen, click the label text) and pick forwardTo from the custom listbox, assert exactly that one checkbox is ticked and the listbox shows forwardTo, then click Create filter with real Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks (a DOM .click() has no user gesture and Gmail's verify-it's-you popup is then blocked) and Continue on the verify dialog the same way. dryRun:true stops right before clicking Create filter.

forwardTo.description: an already-verified forwarding address on this account

dryRun.description: default false; when true, stop right before Create filter and return the asserted state

returns.description: {targetId, dryRun:true, checkedOnes, listboxText} on a dry run; {targetId, created:true, checkedOnes, listboxText} on a real create; {stop:reason} at the step that failed

setSignatureHtml.description: Set a Gmail signature's body from an HTML file. Opens the inbox, then #settings/general (a cold settings load often renders nothing), polls for the Signature editor, real-clicks the signature named name (create:true makes it via Create new), puts the HTML on the macOS clipboard (Trusted Types blocks innerHTML/insertHTML) and pastes it with selectAll + paste key commands, clicks Save Changes, reloads and reads back the editor.

name.description: the signature's display name in Gmail's list

htmlFile.description: absolute path to the HTML file to paste

create.description: default false: stop with signature-not-found when the name is missing; true: create it first

returns.description: {targetId, name, text (editor innerText, first 300 chars), imgs, imgsLoaded (naturalWidth>0), links}; {stop:reason} at the step that failed

findAccountSlot.description: Which signed-in account slot (authuser index) owns an email address. Navigates /mail/u/<n>/ for n=0..maxSlots-1 and matches document.title against the address.

prepareDraftAs.description: Open a prefilled compose (view=cm) in the given account slot and switch the sender to a send-as alias (e.g. a Google Group address). Never sends. The From selector is hidden on this view: real Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks (not element.click()) on the To row, then the revealed From line, then the alias option are required to change it. Returns a readback of To/Subject/From for the caller to verify before calling sendPreparedDraft.

alias.description: substring identifying the send-as option, e.g. the alias address or "Team Dwarves"

returns.description: {targetId, to, subject, from:[...values]} on success; {stop:reason} at the step that failed

sendPreparedDraft.description: WRITE, irreversible. Click Send on a draft opened by prepareDraftAs. Refuses unless confirm:true: this is the point past which the message is outward and cannot be recalled, so the caller must have already read back prepareDraftAs's {to, subject, from} and gotten the human's explicit go-ahead.

confirm.description: must be true; a human has approved From/To/Subject

returns.description: {sent: true} once the compose view closes after the click; {stop:reason} otherwise

verifySent.description: Confirm a message reached Sent by searching in:sent to:<recipient> newer_than:<days>d and counting result rows.

searchRows.description: Open a Gmail search in a background tab and read the result-list rows as text. Uses textContent, not innerText: a background tab returns empty innerText for every row after the first.

returns.description: {rows: string[]} each row whitespace-collapsed and truncated to 200 chars

readThread.description: Open a Gmail search, read the first result row's data-legacy-thread-id, navigate the same target to #search/<query>/<threadId> (clicking the row does nothing in a background tab), expand the whole thread, and return its messages, attachment names, outbound links and recipients. Same search+background-tab mechanics as searchRows.

query.description: Gmail search operators that should resolve to one thread

returns.description: {attachments: string[], links: string[] (non-mail.google.com hrefs), messages: string[], recipients: [{email, name}] (unique [email] attributes)} on a hit; {stop:"no-results", hint} when the search returns nothing; {stop:"no-thread-id", hint} when the first row has no data-legacy-thread-id

composeDraft.description: Open a prefilled compose (view=cm) with To/Cc/Bcc/Subject/Body and optional attachments. Never sends -- Gmail auto-saves the open compose as a draft. Returns a readback to verify before any further action.

returns.description: {targetId, from, recipients: [data-hovercard-id values], subject, attachments: [filenames seen], body: first 200 chars}; {targetId, stop:"no-file-input"} if attachments were given but the file input was not found

replaceDraftBody.description:
Replace the body of an already-open compose (targetId from composeDraft). Gmail's body enforces Trusted Types, so plain lines are written as real DOM text/
nodes (replaceChildren) and an HTML fragment goes through CDP DOM.setOuterHTML on a placeholder div, which bypasses Trusted Types because it is not a page-script innerHTML assignment.

lines.description:
plain-text lines, joined with
; exactly one of lines or html

html.description: an HTML fragment (e.g. a signature); exactly one of lines or html

returns.description: {length: number} body innerText length after the replace; {stop:reason} if the body editable or placeholder was not found

pickSignature.description: In an open compose, open the "Insert signature" menu (visible button whose aria-label or data-tooltip contains "signature") and real-click the menu item whose text equals name. Picks the LAST visible matching leaf (the first match is often a zero-size copy). Reuses an already-open menu: a second click on the button would close it.

name.description: exact menu item text, e.g. "Dwarves LLC (EN)" or "No signature"

returns.description: {signature: innerText of [data-smartmail=gmail_signature] in the body, newlines collapsed, empty string if none} or {stop:"no-sig-button"|"no-signature-item"}

setBodyAboveSignature.description: Rewrite the compose body but keep Gmail's signature block: remove every body child before the top-level ancestor of [data-smartmail=gmail_signature], insert a placeholder div before it, and replace it via DOM.setOuterHTML (Trusted Types blocks innerHTML). With no signature present it behaves like replaceDraftBody html mode.

html.description: an HTML fragment for the text above the signature

returns.description: {length: number} body innerText length after the edit; {stop:reason} if the body editable or placeholder was not found

replaceAttachments.description: Real-click every visible "Remove..." control (aria-label or data-tooltip starting with Remove) inside a chip whose text matches removeMatch until none remain, then attach files with DOM.setFileInputFiles on input[type=file][name=Filedata]. A leftover chip happened once, so the caller must read the returned list.

files.description: absolute host file paths to attach after the removal; omit to only remove

removeMatch.description: regex source tested case-insensitively against the chip text, default "\.(pdf|docx|xlsx)\b" (every pdf, docx and xlsx chip)

returns.description: {attachments: string[]} names of the visible chips after the run; {stop:"no-file-input"} if files were given but the file input was not found

saveDraftNow.description: Force Gmail to save the draft after a DOM-only body edit (which never triggers autosave): focus input[name=subjectbox], caret to the end, Input.insertText a space, Backspace keyDown/keyUp, wait 6s.

returns.description: {subject: string} the subject box value after the save; {stop:"no-subject-box"} if the compose subject field is missing
